description: Use this when the user wants to view their time entries. Returns one page at a time: set limit to the number of entries wanted and page through the rest instead of loading all of them. Supports extensive filtering by organization, team, project, user, tags, and more.

documentId.description: Filter tasks associated with a specific document

endDate.description: Filter tasks ending on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

excludeTaskIds.description: Exclude specific task IDs from results

filter.description: Filter tasks by billing/payment status: all=all tasks, billable=only billable, notBillable=non-billable, paid=payment received, unpaid=not paid, billed=invoice sent, outstanding=billed but unpaid

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return, such as 10 for ten entries. Defaults to 20.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Use with limit to fetch subsequent pages.

populateExpenses.description: Include expense information in task details

populatePauses.description: Include pause/break information in task details

populateTags.description: Include tag details in task information

projectId.description: Filter tasks for a specific project

projectIds.description: Filter tasks by multiple project IDs

rateId.description: Filter tasks by rate/billing rate ID

sort.description: Sort field for tasks: dateTime = by day, newest first unless order is asc, and by start time within a day; time = by start time; created = by creation date

startDate.description: Filter tasks starting on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

teamIds.description: Filter tasks by multiple team IDs

todoId.description: Filter tasks associated with a specific todo/task item

type.description: Filter tasks by type: all=all types, task=regular time entries, mileage=mileage entries, call=call entries

userIds.description: Filter tasks by user IDs (task owners)

name: task_list

tasks.description: List of tasks matching the criteria

totalCount.description: Entries matching the criteria across all pages

title: List Tasks
